_comment: Synthetic test persona: every role, number and claim is fictional. The person block holds CV-only fields; name, email, location and links fall back to profile/person.json.

acme-scale.text: Grew engineering from 12 to 45 engineers across six product and platform teams, with a hiring plan, team charters and a manager bench built from inside.

acme-delivery.text: Cut release lead time from 10 days to under one day by moving every team to trunk-based delivery, feature flags and a shared CI/CD pipeline.

acme-soc2.text: Led the SOC 2 Type II program from gap assessment to a clean first audit, with controls owned by the teams that run the systems.

acme-ai-review.text: Introduced AI-assisted code review and test generation, with human approval on every merge and a weekly review of what the tools got wrong.

acme-llm.text: Shipped an LLM support-ticket triage feature that cut first response time by 40%, with an evaluation set built from past tickets before launch.

acme-cloud.text: Reduced cloud spend by 32% in two quarters through rightsizing, reserved capacity and cost dashboards each team reads on its own.

acme-ladder.text: Wrote the career ladder and performance framework engineering uses today, later adopted by product and design.

acme-tenant.text: Designed the multi-tenant architecture for enterprise customers: SSO and SAML, per-tenant audit logs and data isolation reviewed with customers' security teams.

acme-analytics.text: Built the product analytics stack (event schema, dbt models, warehouse) that replaced three disconnected tools and a spreadsheet of metric definitions.

acme-board.text: Reports DORA metrics and engineering health to the board each quarter, next to the roadmap and hiring plan.

globex-migration.text: Moved 140 services from on-premises hosting to AWS and Kubernetes over 20 months, without a customer-facing outage during cutover.

globex-sre.text: Brought incident rate down 45% with service-level objectives, error budgets and an on-call rotation that paid for the hours it took.

globex-platform-team.text: Formed the platform group (paved-road templates, golden paths, internal developer portal) that cut new-service setup from three weeks to two days.

globex-observability.text: Standardised logging, metrics and tracing across every service, so an on-call engineer could follow one request end to end.

globex-streaming.text: Led the streaming data platform on Kafka and Flink, carrying 2 billion events a day into fraud, pricing and reporting systems.

globex-data-contracts.text: Introduced data contracts between producing and consuming teams, which ended a run of silent schema breaks in downstream reports.

globex-hiring.text: Built a structured interview loop with calibrated rubrics and hired 35 engineers in 18 months, with offer acceptance above 80%.

globex-budget.text: Owned a $6M annual engineering budget and the vendor contracts behind it, renegotiating two that had grown past their use.

globex-mobile.text: Sponsored the mobile app rebuild in React Native, which lifted the store rating from 3.9 to 4.7 within two releases.

globex-remote.text: Ran a remote-first organisation across five time zones with written decisions, recorded demos and overlap hours agreed per team.

initech-tokenization.text: Reduced PCI DSS scope by moving card data behind a tokenization service, taking 30 systems out of the audit boundary.

initech-latency.text: Brought checkout p95 latency from 1.2 s to 400 ms by profiling the payment path, which lifted conversion by 8%.

initech-fraud.text: Built a fraud rules engine with the risk team that cut chargebacks by 25% while keeping manual review volume flat.

initech-team.text: Managed a payments team of nine engineers through two re-platforming projects and a card-network certification.

initech-oncall.text: Set up the team's first on-call rotation and incident reviews, written so the next team could adopt them without a meeting.
